cyber_snare.description: Draw energy tethers to trap viruses in a neon CRT world.

start.intro: System infiltrated. You are the anti-virus.
start.cross_text: to close a loop and execute a Snare.
start.trap: Trap viruses inside the Snare to destroy them.
start.warning_text: If a virus touches your tether before you close it, your integrity drops.

energy.name: BATTERY CAPACITY
energy.description: Increases max energy reserve by +20 per level.

loot.name: DATA EXTRACTION
loot.description: Doubles the amount of Free Space (KB) dropped by viruses.

fw_persist.name: FIREWALL LINGER
fw_persist.description: Firewall remains active on screen as a trap for +1s after drawing.

emp_cascade.name: EMP CASCADE
emp_cascade.description: EMP triggers multiple secondary blasts separated by delays.
